name: Afghani x Colombian Gold (proto-Skunk)
summary: The unnamed first-stage cross behind Skunk #1: an Afghan indica paired with Colombian Gold. It matured late, which led Sacred Seeds to add Acapulco Gold. Accounts differ on who made the original cross; one popular story credits a grower called Jingles before the seeds reached Santa Cruz.

sources.title: Sam the Skunkman: The Evolution of Hybrids
The Story Of Skunk #1
sources.note: Popular retelling, including the Jingles story.
